_purpose: Ground-truth regression fixtures distilled from engineer red-pen (Fable gap #2). Each case = a label the extractor MUST type/classify a specific way, per an engineer ruling. Run tests/test_glossary_goldens.py after ANY glossary/extractor-prompt change; a break here means a change silently regressed an approved rule (the XA-tap scar). These are GLOSSARY-LEVEL goldens (label -> expected element_type / disposition), cheap and deterministic — not the vision gold fixtures (gold_fixtures_gelliceaux.json).

cases.label: Junction/tap block pin 4 (upper group)
cases.hint: diamond with a number on a wire
cases.reason: wire-gauge callout mm2, not a status signal

cases.label: G3-K337 Position Sensor A HI
cases.reason: CAN-bus conductor, a signal not power

cases.label: G3-K336 Shield (Position Sensor A circuit shield)
SWITCH PORT — with HVIL

cases.reason: harness connector/plug, NOT a mechanical switch (the plug-mistaken-for-switch trap)

cases.reason: isolator breaker even with S prefix

cases.label: F3 60A

cases.reason: fuse, not a status signal near a tap

cases.label: see DWG 117

cases.label: CP-SW (see DWG110d)
cases.hint: wired element carrying a DWG reference
cases.reason: THE WIRE IS THE TEST — a wired cross-drawing ref stays an element (the CP-SW scar; it was a real pump feed)

cases.label: CBx.4 BEL CAN BUS ISOLATORS
cases.reason: SHEET-SCOPED VOCAB: CBx on these sheets = retractable fuse, not breaker

cases.label: S1 selector for voltmeter L1-L2/L2-L3/L3-L1
cases.reason: gauge/display-selection control, not a power switch

cases.label: PLUG C [8] ALARM MOD 2 PORT PEDESTAL
cases.reason: PIN RULE: a pin is not a load; attaches to the equipment its plug serves (follow the line to the header)

cases.label: 12 / 69 not used
cases.hint: wire number + terminal on a multi-core cable, spare
cases.reason: MULTI-CORE CABLE rule (pending approval): wire+terminal, not equipment; 'not used' = spare

cases.label: PORT NAV. LT.
cases.reason: NAV-LIGHTS RULE: nav/steaming lights are ALWAYS their own node, separate from general lighting (safety-critical)

cases.label: #1 SERVICES
cases.reason: FEEDER != LOAD: a distribution box is not equipment

cases.label: CT11 FWD WATER HEATER
cases.reason: CT = current transmitter -> monitoring node, cross-linked to measured equipment

cases.reason: earth-leak breaker attaches to the equipment it protects
